    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - true prices consistently exceed model predictions",
    "The gap between model and true prices increases over the 30-day horizon as prices continue rising",
    "Model lacks sensitivity to positive sentiment shifts - uses 0.67 max even with strong demand signals",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model doesn't adjust downward enough (uses -0.33 min instead of expected more negative)",
    "Mean reversion bias in model - forecasts cluster around price history mean rather than reflecting true price momentum",
    "Sentiment of 1.00 (strong buy) only affects forecast by +0.30 max, insufficient for true +3-4% daily moves",
    "Model treats all sentiment levels as roughly equal in magnitude - 0.67 and 0.33 show <1% forecast impact while true prices move 2-4%"
] }
